source.origin: project-authored boot stub listing, contract 1 (plan 04-14, D-28)

note: project boot stub, not an EXEC; never used as proof of EXEC compatibility; built images live only in the build tree. The listing is a hand-assembled annotated text listing (D-25, D-26): every word is derived by hand from the project's CP-1610 notes and the manual pages it cites, with no assembler and nothing copied from another implementation. tools/pack builds the 8192-byte EXEC image from it into build/<preset>/images/boot-stub.exec; no image is committed. Any edit of the listing refreshes the outputs entry (cmake -E sha256sum and size) in the same commit.
